name: Sonoma County Behavioral Health Provider Directory
description: Sonoma County's official behavioral health provider directories, listing mental health clinics and substance use disorder treatment providers serving county residents.
fullDescription: Sonoma County's official behavioral health provider directories, listing mental health clinics and substance use disorder treatment providers serving county residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Mental health provider directory (PDF, 2026, English and Spanish)
- Substance use disorder provider directory (PDF, 2026, English and Spanish)
- 24-hour Access Team for mental health screening, assessment, and referral
- Adult (18+) and youth (0-20) outpatient mental health services for Medi-Cal members
- Crisis services information
howToGetIt: Download the provider directories from the county's Medi-Cal Informing Materials page, or call the 24-hour Access Line at 707-565-6900 or toll-free 1-800-870-8786 for help finding mental health services in Sonoma County.
keywords: Sonoma, Santa Rosa, mental health, substance use, provider directory, therapist, counselor, drug treatment, psychiatrist, clinic, behavioral health
